candidate2_cross_system_nongrounded.prediction: At a FIXED added-competitor abundance the operator predicts miR-92/25 (small guide pool) is derepressed while miR-122 (large guide pool) is not, because derepression turns on when added sites approach the guide pool. This is the FALSIFIABLE cross-system ordering.
candidate2_cross_system_nongrounded.why_not_grounded: Requirement (i) needs A and B to share the SAME focal-target sites so the independent scorer is indifferent. miR-122 and miR-92/25 are different guides and cannot share a reporter site; the identical reporter in the config is a modeling construct, so this is recorded for a future camera-ready that finds a shared-reporter dataset, and is NOT counted as evidence.
